contexts.text: A corrupt man is here treated of.
The earth is called corrupt (), from direful persuasions... To corrupt, is predicated of the things of the understanding.
That to corrupt is predicated of persuasions. Illustrated. AC 1326:5.
Corrupt () = that there is nothing but falsity.
Because all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth () = that man's Corporeal had destroyed all understanding of truth.
To corrupt (), when said of the truth of faith, here signified by the eye, = to extinguish. AC 9061.
To corrupt themselves (), when said of worship, = to turn themselves away from the Divine.
These are means of corruption; to draw men to their side.
Thus the world is now corrupt...

Ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi () = That the Church with the Israelites had perverted the truths of the Word, and thence the goods of life, and had thus destroyed conjunction with the Lord. AE 701:9.
(The signification of corrupt further illustrated.) AE 725:11. AE 750:5. AE 768:19. AE 863:16. AE 1201.
Sons that are corrupters () = the falsities of those who are in falsity from that evil.
